js: (function(){var T=__dbg.THREE;var bed=__dbg.bed;bed.updateMatrixWorld(true);var bb=new T.Box3().setFromObject(bed);var rc=new T.Raycaster();rc.firstHitOnly=false;var down=new T.Vector3(0,-1,0);var hits=[];var N=11;var raw=[];for(var i=0;i<N;i++)for(var j=0;j<N;j++){var x=bb.min.x+(i+0.5)/N*(bb.max.x-bb.min.x);var z=bb.min.z+(j+0.5)/N*(bb.max.z-bb.min.z);rc.set(new T.Vector3(x,bb.max.y+3,z),down);var hs=rc.intersectObject(bed,true);var top=null;for(var k=0;k<hs.length;k++){if(!hs[k].object.visible)continue;if(top===null||hs[k].point.y>top)top=hs[k].point.y;}var rel=(top===null)?null:+(top-bed.position.y).toFixed(3);hits.push(rel);raw.push({x:+x.toFixed(2),z:+z.toFixed(2),y:rel});}var ok=hits.filter(function(v){return v!==null;});var s=ok.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});var hist={};ok.forEach(function(v){var b=(Math.round(v*20)/20).toFixed(2);hist[b]=(hist[b]||0)+1;});var top5=Object.keys(hist).sort(function(a,b){return hist[b]-hist[a];}).slice(0,5).map(function(k){return k+'×'+hist[k];});return JSON.stringify({bedOriginY:+bed.position.y.toFixed(3),bedTopTarget:+(bed.position.y+__rig.rig.bed.top-bed.position.y).toFixed(3),surfaceWorld:+__rig.rig.bed.top.toFixed(3),rayHits:ok.length,of:N*N,min:s[0],p25:s[Math.floor(s.length*0.25)],median:s[Math.floor(s.length*0.5)],p75:s[Math.floor(s.length*0.75)],max:s[s.length-1],modes:top5,boxSize:bb.getSize(new T.Vector3()).toArray().map(function(v){return +v.toFixed(3);})});})()
